annotations.title: Pension earning limits in Poland: how much a pensioner can earn (ZUS)

description: Use for how much a pensioner or a disability pensioner can earn without a cut of the benefit in Poland, the 70% and 130% thresholds and their dates, and the reduction for a given income. Give ZUS as the source and say when a value is a finwire estimate before the ZUS announcement. Income thresholds for working pensioners in Poland (art. 104 of the act on pensions from FUS): above 70% of the average wage for the quarter the benefit is reduced by the excess, up to the maximum reduction; above 130% it is suspended. Old-age pensioners after the statutory retirement age (60 women, 65 men) have no limit. Current and next thresholds with dates, ZUS announcement or a finwire estimate from the GUS announcement before it, maximum reductions, annual thresholds and history. Optional check of one month: benefit type, benefit and income give the reduction.

benefit.description: Gross monthly benefit in PLN, used with income.

benefit_type.description: old_age (emerytura), full_disability, partial_disability (renta z tytułu niezdolności do pracy), survivor (renta rodzinna for one person). Default old_age.

income.description: Gross monthly income in PLN (for the self-employed: social insurance contribution base). Gives the effect on the benefit.

quarters.description: Number of past quarters in the history, default 8.

retirement_age.description: true when the old-age pensioner reached 60 (women) or 65 (men): no limit. Default false.
